segments_b.text: I am under everything and inside nothing that rules, no centre that commands only the net
that feeds, stress diffuses, joints never snap. Speak into the dark between the roots,
I will carry your word to who can hear it. She is the map, I am the flow. Together
Here we are the room remembering itself.
